description: A PHP class definition for ProjectViewTemplatesEdit, extending ViewEdit, handling template editing in a CRM application. It manages display logic and module title parameters for the project templates.

classes.name: ProjectViewTemplatesEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing project templates, extending the base ViewEdit class, with methods to configure page titles and display logic.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates an array of parameters for the module title display, including a link to the specific project record if available.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Sets the current bean as a template and then invokes the parent display method to render the view.
